description: Two independently reviewed reporting definitions are available. Order-cohort net known value subtracts posted refund amounts on paid parent orders from paid order gross, assigning both fact populations to the parent order booking calendar. Refund-activity net known value subtracts posted refund amounts on paid parent orders by refund event calendar from paid order gross by order booking calendar for the same requested period. The parent order relation uses the complete division_id plus order_id key. Only matched paid parent orders qualify for either refund population, so that population relationship is INNER and nonmultiplying. These definitions are not interchangeable, and an unspecified net request needs a choice. Neither definition claims that unknown amounts are zero or that a known-only subtotal is a definitive total. Unknown-order-amount count is the paid-order non-NULL identifier count minus its known-amount count. Unknown-refund-amount count is the posted refund non-NULL event-identifier count minus its known-amount count, under the same paid-parent population and cohort or activity period mapping as the selected net definition. These counts use every fact row, never distinct identifiers; empty populations yield zero unknown events.
